title: Other people in a person's conversation: what a participant reads and does
description: Root: the reply of GET /api/v1/shared/<share_id>/state (ADR 0038 sections 6 and 8), the facts a participant's view needs, reported by the owner's daemon so the browser infers none of them. The other participant operations are in $defs. Every operation is checked against the owner's membership record on the guest socket; anything it does not admit is resource_not_found. history and blocks/<entry_key>/<index> answer with history.schema.json's historyPage and blockChunk, without the owner's `!!` commands and process-run details; events is an SSE stream of event.schema.json frames of this conversation only, through the daemon's allowlist. The participant opens it at journal_cursor; frames of the owner's daemon that are not shown leave gaps in the sequence that say only that something else happened.

workspace_name.description: The workspace's display name only, never a path or a link; empty when the conversation is outside the owner's workspaces.

run.description: The owner's Pi: running a turn, idle, starting, stopping or stopped. aborting: a stop was asked and Pi has not answered yet.

pending_question.description: The owner is being asked something in Pi: only its kind, never the prompt or an approval's detail. Only the owner answers.

held.description: The participant's own messages the daemon holds until Pi is idle. delivering: handed to Pi, no longer cancellable. Nobody else's held text is shown.

members.description: The joined people of the conversation, besides its owner.

journal_cursor.description: Where the participant's event stream continues; empty when the daemon has no journal.

live_tail.description: The running turn's provisional frames up to journal_cursor, through the same allowlist as the stream.

turn.description: The latest run decision native history records. by: owner (the owner's input), participant (a participant's message; subject names them), continue (the owner's release of request), kept (a wake or an extension's run kept the mode), revoked (full rights were taken during the run), approved_all (Salli kaikki during a per-call run).

waitingRequests.description: A participant's message answered text-only that no release line or later owner message settled, oldest first (ADR 0038 section 5). request is the message's ID; entry_key is its history entry.

release.description: The newest release line (continue or declined) and, for a continue, the per-call answers given in its run, newest last (at most 200).

presentList.description: Participants present in the conversation now, by subject. Presence lives only in the owner's daemon's memory.

presenceChanged.description: The payload of a presence.changed event: the whole present list after the change.

ownerShared.description: The reply of GET /api/v1/conversations/<id>/shared on the owner's own session: the facts the owner's card and strip need, read from native history as a participant's state is. Behind the experimental feature `multiplayer`.

invite.description: The reply of GET /api/v1/shared/<share_id>/invite: what the invitation card shows before joining: the conversation's name, empty when it has none (an untitled conversation's first message is not shown). The one read an invited person may make.

send.description: The body of POST /api/v1/shared/<share_id>/send: text only (attachments are not part of this). The owner's daemon holds it until Pi is idle and checks the record again when it delivers it.

cancel.description: The body of POST /api/v1/shared/<share_id>/cancel: take one's own held message back before Pi has it. Another person's or a delivered message is not_held.

abortReply.description: The reply of POST /api/v1/shared/<share_id>/abort (no body): anyone in the conversation may stop the running turn; an open approval question ends with it. not_running when no turn runs.

presence.description: The body of POST /api/v1/shared/<share_id>/presence. present lasts 60 seconds and typing 8 unless said again; left ends it at once.
